name: SHOVELHEAD
source:
In "SHOVELHEAD," a hand-painted interactive horror experience, you awaken buried alive, surrounded by the stench of death and the thirst for blood. Led by a mysterious and unsettling hitchhiker, you must navigate a chilling world of vampires and deception, where every decision counts. Will you obey and become a pawn in the hitchhiker's twisted game, or dare to challenge the enigmatic antagonist and uncover the secrets of your newfound existence?

[from [url=https://thornback.itch.io/shovelhead]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在手绘互动恐怖体验“SHOVELHEAD”中，你被活埋了，被死亡的恶臭和对鲜血的渴望所包围。在一位神秘而令人不安的搭便车者的带领下，你必须穿越一个充满吸血鬼和欺骗的令人毛骨悚然的世界，在这里，每一个决定都至关重要。你会服从并成为搭便车者扭曲游戏中的棋子，还是敢于挑战神秘的对手并揭开你新发现的存在的秘密？

[来自[url=https://thornback.itch.io/shovelhead]itch.io[/url]]
